title: the scheduling siblings of setTimeout, and structuredClone, are the same host authority
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals'. `setTimeout` and `setInterval` were refused while `queueMicrotask`, `clearTimeout`, and `clearInterval` were not, which is the exact shape of a denylist rather than a rule. `structuredClone` additionally detaches an ArrayBuffer through `{ transfer: [...] }`, which falsifies poc/src/platform/host.ts's `fillRandomBytes` `@throws {never}` claim, because `getRandomValues` throws on a detached view.
